source: admin_inventory (closeout_admin_inventory.json request; its twin sweep finding sweep:read_aloud:target)
problem: read_aloud of an unfamiliar (novel) thing reads its true type's read-tier fields: an unfamiliar tissue box, napkin pack, toilet roll, document or mail piece is read aloud ({"read": ..., "seconds": 10}) while an unfamiliar kettle, soap pump, label maker or suitcase is refused 'There is nothing legible to read on it'.
cause: house_sim/systems/people/care.py _printed_fields has no novel filter; core read keeps only core.NOVEL_PRINT (text, label_text) of an unfamiliar thing, and since the close-out only non-blank print (core.printed_value).
change: Read aloud an unfamiliar thing (ctx.unfamiliar(eid), the kernel helper added in the close-out) from its printed text alone, as core read does: core.NOVEL_PRINT fields with core.printed_value, else the one refusal. Repro: a realistic scene with {'op': 'spawn', 'type': 'tissue_box', 'props': {'novel': True, 'size_m': [0.2, 0.15, 0.25]}} vs type electric_kettle, robot near, a resident present, read_aloud <handle> (scratch p1c_admin_inventory/twins_generic.py novel_admin out.json --sweep).

problem: read_aloud before read tells the spray_bottle look-alikes apart: an unread all_purpose_cleaner is read out (True, '') while an unread spray_bottle or trigger_bottle (blank label) is refused 'There is nothing legible to read on it' (perception), room and geometric camera. The perception audit's read probe reads before it reads aloud, and read resolves the labelled members, so it never compares this.
cause: house_sim/systems/people/care.py _printed_fields returns [] for a blank label, where core read answers a blank label {"label_text": ""} ok (a look-alike member; an unfamiliar thing's blank label reads like no label since the close-out).
change: Answer a blank label of a look-alike member as core read does (ok, nothing read out, e.g. 'The label is blank'), or decide and pin why the refusal is the right form; optionally add a read_aloud-first twin to tools/perception_audit.py's read probe (a kernel tool: phase 2). Repro: tests/test_mechanisms.py House(); h.add('bottle', T, 'table'); h.person('adult_1', 'living', [1, 5]); HouseEnv(h.env(room='living', pos=(3, 5))._initial, None, 0, perception='realistic', camera=C); approach; read_aloud for T in all_purpose_cleaner / spray_bottle / trigger_bottle (scratch p1c_mechanisms/aloud_first.py).

cause: The verbs check the destination's container / openable / capacity before anything refuses an unfamiliar thing. Since the close-out core.place_item refuses an unfamiliar destination (ctx.refuse_unfamiliar) -- but these verbs' own checks run before it.
